title: query find-callers
summary: Lists callers of a routine by name, with an option to restrict results to precise, resolved callers
intro: Read this to see who calls a routine. Give it the bare member name; with --resolved it keeps only precise, resolved callers and also shows who reads or writes a property or field.

flags.name: --resolved
flags.summary: precise callers via resolved call_edges (grouped by target, certain|ambiguous); a PROPERTY/FIELD name lists its bound accesses [certain, read|write]; an ENUM VALUE name lists each bound read [certain, read] (resolver 1.6.0-alpha)

flags.name: --json
flags.summary: every row ends with a derived "resolution" key: exact | ambiguous | external | name-only (text totals: N callers (a exact, b name-only)); a site that reaches the target only through an interface method also carries "via", "via_kind" and, for an ambiguous implements edge, "via_edge" (RB-5), placed before "resolution"

help: --resolved: precise callers via resolved call_edges (grouped by target, certain|ambiguous);
a PROPERTY/FIELD name lists its bound accesses [certain, read|write];
an ENUM VALUE name lists each bound read [certain, read] (resolver 1.6.0-alpha)
--json: every row ends with "resolution": exact|ambiguous|external|name-only (derived; XERJ item 3)
a method reached only THROUGH an interface lists those sites as a separate "via IFoo.Bar dispatch" group;
--json rows gain "via" (interface method QName), "via_kind" ("interface") and, when the implements edge is ambiguous, "via_edge" (RB-5)
drag-lint query --kind <k> --all [--public] [--db ...] [--json]   (list EVERY symbol of one kind -- no name, no doc clause, no row cap; e.g. every unit in a DB)

steps: Needs an index of the project
Put the editor caret on the routine

pitfalls: the BARE member name. --name TFoo.Bar silently returns 0; --name Bar returns the sites.
notes: issued by the plugin from TDragLintCodeLensCache.PopulateOnce (DragLint.Plugin.CodeLensCache.pas)
